uplift.description: The line's share of the minimum groups' uplifts, in its net value. In the document currency, to its decimals: two in `EUR`.

groups.description: The `id`s of the minimum groups the line shares.

processes.description: The bill by process, without the charges.

ItemPricing.description: The item's pricing: SD's condition lines and the net value, in the document currency.

procedure.description: The pricing procedure the sales area runs (V/08).

netValue.description: The item's net value. In the document currency, to its decimals: two in `EUR`.

notes.description: What pricing could not do, as the pricing analysis reports it: a key with no record, a missing basis.

LineBars.description: The bars the press runs for the line, under the plant's cutting optimization or a bar per piece: `ZA_BARS`, `ZA_PIECES_PER_BAR`, `ZA_PRESS_BAR_MM`.

count.description: The bars pressed, a whole number.

piecesPerBar.description: The pieces one bar is cut into, a whole number.

length.description: Each bar's length, whole millimetres today: `ZA_PRESS_BAR_MM` holds no decimals (CT04). In millimetres, `MMT`, to its decimals: none in `H87`, the piece, three in any other unit.

LineCounts.description: How many of the order's lines stand where: every line, by status; those at or above their minimum that the user exit rounded up, `rounded` (`ZSD_AVC/002`); and those below it, lifted to it and rounded up, `belowMinimum` (`ZSD_AVC/001`), never both.

LinePack.description: One pack the order quantity's user exit packed the line in, biggest first: the facts its message words.

bundle.description: The pack, the packaging list's bundle.

count.description: How many of it, a whole number.

pieces.description: The line's pieces in this bundle, a whole number; `count` is them over a full pack's `pieces`, rounded up, the last possibly part-full.

LinePacking.description: How a line's pieces are packed in one carrier its crates are of: the pieces a full pack holds. How its packs lie there is each crate's `bands`.

carrier.description: The carrier, as its crates name it: `AW1`, `AW1/2`, `AW1/3`.

packingValue.description: `ZA_PACKING_VALUE`, the pieces a full pack holds: where the packs travel inside the crate, each pack's; else the crate's own, a full crate's pieces. Read off the packaging list by the profile, the finish and the pack, always where the line enters its profile; absent where it enters none, as a catalogue profile does, and its crate is the pack.

LineQuantity.description: A line's quantity: as `entered` — the request's, echoed, which SAP keeps nowhere once the user exit has run — the `order` quantity the order quantity's user exit left, `VBAP-KWMENG`, and their unit; the unit's SAP key in the detail view.

entered.description: The quantity the request gave. In `unit`, to its decimals: none in `H87`, the piece, three in any other unit.

order.description: `VBAP-KWMENG`, as the user exit left it. In `unit`, to its decimals: none in `H87`, the piece, three in any other unit.

unit.description: The line's unit, the material's. Its UN/ECE Recommendation 20 common code — the table in the document's description — with SAP's internal key beside it.

sapUnit.description: SAP's internal key of `unit` (`T006-MSEHI`), which no logon language changes: `ST` for the piece, which SD's English screens print `PC`.

LineStatus.description: Where a line of the order stands, and the order with it: `ok` complete and consistent; `incomplete` with values still to enter; `inconsistent` an entry a dependency or the characteristic's format refuses; `refused` an item SD would not create — a material no sales order configures, or, answered alike, one sold in no sales area the sign-in acts in for one of its customers — the one-time customer's for a sign-in linked to none — the inquiry's material aside (`UNKNOWN_MATERIAL`); one sold in another of them but not the order's (`V1/382`); a characteristic its class does not allocate or an order cannot enter (`UNKNOWN_CHARACTERISTIC`) — which is not priced, joins no group and counts in no net value. Worst first: refused, inconsistent, incomplete, ok; the order's is the worst of all its lines, a refused one too. A status a later version adds reads as `inconsistent`. Open: a value a later version adds reads as `inconsistent`.

LineWeights.description: A line's weights, `VBAP-NTGEW` and `-BRGEW`, for its order quantity: theoretical, the profile's weight per metre (an inquiry's, its entered estimate) times its length and `quantity.order`, computed, not weighed. The net value binds, not the weight.

net.description: The net weight. In `unit`, to its decimals: none in `H87`, the piece, three in any other unit.

gross.description: The gross weight. In `unit`, to its decimals: none in `H87`, the piece, three in any other unit.

unit.description: Their unit. Its UN/ECE Recommendation 20 common code — the table in the document's description — with SAP's internal key beside it.

sapUnit.description: SAP's internal key of `unit` (`T006-MSEHI`), which no logon language changes: `ST` for the piece, which SD's English screens print `PC`.

LoadCarrier.description: A carrier the plan's crates may be of, by the planner's own name, the inside its packs fill and what it weighs empty: once per carrier, so a crate's section is drawn to scale. A crate of packs is the smallest carrier its packs fit, each band lying in it whichever way round stands lower for its packs, the carrier's full count the way it holds the most, the face as measured where both hold as many; each crate's `smaller` says what they would stand in each smaller carrier.

carrier.description: The carrier, as each crate names it: `AW1`, `AW1/2`, `AW1/3`.

text.description: The name a reader knows it by: `Full crate`, `Half crate`, `Third crate`.

insideWidth.description: What it holds across, inside its walls. In millimetres, to hundredths.

insideHeight.description: What it holds up, inside its walls. In millimetres, to hundredths.

emptyWeight.description: What it weighs empty, which each crate of it weighs beside its goods against the payload: LINKIN's estimate. In kilograms, `KGM`, to its decimals: none in `H87`, the piece, three in any other unit.

LoadPlan.description: `POST /customer/v1/load-plan`: the lines and issued quotations loaded onto standard trucks — an estimate of how much fits, by weight and by size, to size the order: not a loading plan. Prices are ex works. Every line and item given is on the trucks: one that cannot be refuses the plan, `NOT_PLANNABLE`. Crates of one width stand side by side across the truck and stack under a margin to its roof, about four full crates high, a shorter crate on a longer one flush with its front end, as many trucks as their floor and the legal payload take, each crate weighing its goods and its own empty weight. No delivery and no shipment: nothing is kept, nothing priced, and the plan is on no issued document. The weights are theoretical, the profiles' weight per metre over their length.

summary.description: The plan in plain sentences, first: what a person reads, the app's words.

lines.description: The body's lines, in its order.

documents.description: The body's issued quotations, in its order.

carriers.description: Every carrier of the bundles its lines travel in, used or not, the smallest first: the order a crate of packs tries them in.

fills.description: For each article `fill` names, in its order, a number of packs more with which a plan still takes as many trucks, not the most that could; absent where the body names none.

emptyWeightCounted.description: Whether the crates' own empty weight is counted against the payload: each carrier's `emptyWeight`, LINKIN's estimate.

axlesChecked.description: Whether each truck's axle loads are checked: the planner checks no axle loads, so always `false`.

stacksFewest.description: Whether the stacks of each crate length and width are as few as its crates allow, before shorter crates are set on longer ones; `false` where an order of many crate types passed the planner's work and stacked them in order, a truck more possible.

trucks.description: The trucks, each with its crates where they stand.

LoadPlanDocument.description: An issued quotation of the body, by its number, and its items planned: every item, or those the body named, in the quotation's order.

number.description: The number, as the body gave it.

items.description: Its items planned, in the quotation's order.

LoadPlanDocumentRequest.description: `POST /customer/v1/load-plan`: one issued quotation to plan, by its number, whole or the items named.

number.description: The document's number as issuing answered it, at most 10 characters: `LQ` a quotation's, and eight digits. An inquiry's, `LI`, is never planned: it refuses the plan, `NOT_PLANNABLE`. Another shape, or a number given twice, is `INVALID_REQUEST` with its `pointer`.

items.description: An item's number as the quotation numbers it, `VBAP-POSNR`: digits, not all zero, at most 6 characters.

`VBAP-POSNR`, the quotation's items to plan, each as the quotation numbers it, 1 to 6 digits, its leading zeros dropped: 1 to 300, each once; every item where left out. None, more than 300, a number given twice or of another shape is refused with its `pointer`; an item the quotation does not hold refuses the plan, `NOT_PLANNABLE`.

LoadPlanFill.description: More packs of an article `fill` names, as a plan made with them took them: never that every smaller amount fits, nor the same crates on the same trucks, since a new plan crates the packs and loads the trucks afresh; nor that the plant ships so many.

document.description: The quotation's number, where the article is one of its items.

item.description: `VBAP-POSNR`, the line or item, as `lines` and `documents` number it.

packs.description: The packs more, each full, as the order quantity exit adds them for more pieces: of packs inside crates, the article's pack holding the most pieces; of a line whose crates are its packs, its biggest crate by the exit's rounding value, which it fills whole before a part crate. The most the search found with which a plan takes as many trucks as this one, by plans made, never past what the payload takes, and not the most that could; 0 where it found none.

finished.description: Whether the search went to its end: `false` where it stopped first, its count of plans or the plan's time spent. `true` proves nothing past `packs`: the trucks a plan takes do not grow with the packs alone, so a plan with more may still take as many.

LoadPlanFillRequest.description: `POST /customer/v1/load-plan`: an article to fill — a line of the body, by its `item`, or an item of a quotation `documents` names, by its `document`, the quotation's number, and its `item`. The plan is made again with more full packs of it, to find a number of them with which a plan still takes as many trucks (`fills`): not the most that could, since the trucks a plan takes do not grow with the packs alone.

document.description: The quotation's number as `documents` names it, at most 10 characters, where the article is one of its items; left out for a line of the body. A number `documents` does not name is `INVALID_REQUEST`.

item.description: `VBAP-POSNR`, the line or item as the answer numbers it: digits, not all zero, at most 6 characters, its leading zeros dropped, the body's lines 10, 20, 30 in order where the body numbers none. One the plan does not load, or an article named twice, is `INVALID_REQUEST`.

LoadPlanHeader.description: Whom the plan is for: the sold-to party (`VBAK-KUNNR`), with its leading zeros, and the sales area.

soldToParty.description: `VBAK-KUNNR`, one of digits alone with its leading zeros.

LoadPlanLine.description: A line of the body, or an item of an issued quotation, its crates on the trucks: named as the order and the quotation name it — the buyer's own item and material where given, the product number and the specification in one line — its pieces' cut length, and the pieces a full pack holds in each carrier its crates are of. Its crates are found by their `contents`.

item.description: `VBAP-POSNR`: the line's place 10, 20, 30 while the body numbers no line.

customerItem.description: `VBAP-POSEX`, as the body gave it or the quotation was issued with it.

customerMaterial.description: `VBAP-KDMAT`, as the body gave it or the quotation was issued with it.

text.description: The specification in one short line, the order's and the quotation's own: `7099999 · Window frame · T5, standard · 4500 mm · Powder coated`.

geometry.description: `ZA_GEOMETRY`, the profile number the line entered; absent for a catalogue profile, which its product number names.

surfaceFinish.description: `ZA_SURFACE_FINISH`, the finish's value as the line entered it: `BARE`, `ANODIZED`, `POWDER_COATED` and the rest of its Values tab.

colour.description: The line's colour in one phrase, off its configuration's values: a powder's colour, surface and class, `RAL 9016, smooth gloss, Qualicoat 1`; an anodizing's pretreatment and colour; a second side's after `side 2`. A powder named without its system, surface or class has them as the configuration infers them from its number, so it reads as one named in full. Two lines of one profile in one crate, in different colours, are told apart by it. The shared crates fill by the same values, after the profile. Absent where the line has no colour, a bare one.

cutLength.description: `ZA_LENGTH_MM`, the pieces' cut length, the bars its crates hold. In whole millimetres.

packing.description: How its pieces are packed in each carrier its crates are of, the smallest first: once per carrier.

LoadPlanRequest.description: `POST /customer/v1/load-plan`: the body — the customer and its sales area, then the lines to plan, priced again as one order, and the issued quotations to plan, by number: at least one line or document, any mix.

salesOrganization.description: `VBAK-VKORG`, required with the distribution channel: the sales area the lines are priced in and the documents were issued in.

soldToParty.description: `VBAK-KUNNR`, the customer whose lines and issued quotations are planned: a customer number of at most 10 characters, digits alone read with their leading zeros (`9999999` is `0009999999`), one the customer master holds and extends to the sales area, else `UNKNOWN_SOLD_TO_PARTY`. Its documents are found under it, in the sales area. It holds no control, bidirectional or invisible character, Unicode 17.0.0's default-ignorable code points among them but ZWNJ, ZWJ and the variation selectors: those the pattern names, and U+1BCA0 to U+1BCA3, U+1D173 to U+1D17A, U+E0000 to U+E00FF and U+E01F0 to U+E0FFF, beyond U+FFFF. Its length is counted in UTF-16 code units, as SAP counts a CHAR field: a character beyond U+FFFF counts two.

items.description: The lines to plan, as `POST /customer/v1/order` takes them: at most 300, more is `TOO_MANY_ITEMS`. They are priced again as one order, nothing kept.

documents.description: The issued quotations to plan, by number, whole or the items named: at most 10, more is `TOO_MANY_ITEMS`.

fill.description: The articles to fill, at most 5, more is `TOO_MANY_ITEMS`: for each, a number of full packs more with which a plan still takes as many trucks (`fills`), not the most. A line whose crate is its pack, with no packing value to add a full one by, is `INVALID_REQUEST`.

LoadPlanSummary.description: The plan in plain sentences, for a person: what a customer reads first, the same words the app shows. An estimate of how much fits, to size the order: never a loading plan, a booking or how the plant loads.

head.description: The trucks, the crates and their gross weight: `2 trucks carry all 57 crates, 34.9 t gross.`

reason.description: Why so many trucks, from `boundBy` and `provenLeast`: `Their weight, the space they take and their long crates need 2 trucks: no plan takes fewer.` Absent where the bound is 1 and the plan takes 1.

smaller.description: What one truck fewer would need, from `toSaveATruck`: `One truck fewer would need an order at least 597 kg lighter, crates included, and at least 23 % of one truck's space smaller; only a new plan shows whether that is enough.` A part whose figure rounds down to nothing in these words is left out. Absent where `toSaveATruck` is absent, or where every part is left out.

fills.description: A sentence per article `fill` names, from `fills`, in its order, each with the article's line or item: `A plan with 333 more packs (3,996 pieces) of 7099999 in RAL 9016, smooth gloss, Qualicoat 1 (line 130) still takes 2 trucks.` Of the plan, never of a truck. Absent where the body names none.

trucks.description: A sentence per truck, in the trucks' order: its crates, its gross weight of its payload, its space taken in whole percent rounded down, its longest crate.

closing.description: `An estimate of how much fits in a standard truck, to size the order: not a loading plan.`

LoadPlanTotals.description: The plan's totals: its trucks and crates, their goods' net weight, what they weigh with the crates' own, and how few trucks any load of the crates could take.

netWeight.description: The goods' net weight, theoretical, the crates' own left out. In kilograms, `KGM`, to its decimals: none in `H87`, the piece, three in any other unit.

grossWeight.description: The goods' net weight and the crates' own empty weight: what the trucks' payload holds. In kilograms, `KGM`, to its decimals: none in `H87`, the piece, three in any other unit.

bound.description: A bound under the trucks: no load of the crates, each lying along the truck and stacked no higher than `stackHeight`, takes fewer, whatever stands on what — by their weight, their length and height against the lanes and the stacks' height, and the long ones a truck holds one behind the other and one above another — so the fewest trucks any such load needs is at least this.

provenLeast.description: Whether no load of the crates, each lying along the truck, takes fewer trucks: `trucks` is `bound`.

boundBy.description: What sets `bound`, where it is above 1: each term of it that reaches it, in the order `weight`, `space`, `longCrates`. It sets the bound, not the plan: where `provenLeast` is false the planner's own count is above it. Absent where the bound is 1.

toSaveATruck.description: What one truck fewer would need of the order, at the least, where the plan takes more than one truck and is proven least, and its gross weight is past one truck fewer's payloads or its space past one truck fewer's by a tenth of a percent or more; absent otherwise.

LoadedCrate.description: One crate as it stands in its truck: its carrier and size, where it stands — its corner nearest the front wall, the left side and the floor, in whole millimetres along, across and up the truck — its goods' net weight, and what it holds: one line's or issued quotation's item's, or the packs of several of one cut length.

carrier.description: The carrier, by the planner's own name: `AW1`, `AW1/2`, `AW1/3`.

length.description: What it takes along the truck: its bars' cut length, at least its carrier's shortest. In whole millimetres.

width.description: What it takes across the truck. In whole millimetres.

height.description: What it takes up the truck. In whole millimetres.

x.description: From the front wall. In whole millimetres.

y.description: From the left side. In whole millimetres.

z.description: From the floor. In whole millimetres.

netWeight.description: Its goods' net weight, theoretical, the crate's own left out: its `contents`' together. In kilograms, `KGM`, to its decimals: none in `H87`, the piece, three in any other unit.

contents.description: What it holds, a line or an issued quotation's item each, in the order its packs fill it: their net weight adds up to the crate's. A crate that is its pack holds one, without `packs`, and is never shared; a crate of packs holds one cut length, its lines' rests where it holds several (a line's full crates stay its own).

bands.description: Its packs in bands of rows, floor up, a band each profile's face and turn, where its packs travel inside it by their face; absent where the crate is the pack. Each line's packs in its bands add up to its `contents` entry's.

smaller.description: What all its packs would stand in each carrier of its bundle smaller than its own, smallest first, as the planner lays them there when it picks the crate: why it is not of one of them. Absent where it is of its bundle's smallest carrier, or is the pack.

LoadedTruck.description: One truck of the plan: the vehicle, its inside and its payload, the goods' net weight on it and its gross weight with the crates' own, how much of it they take and leave, and its crates, lane by lane from the left side, each lane front to back, each stack bottom to top.

vehicle.description: The planning vehicle, by the planner's own name: `SEMI_13_6`.

payload.description: The legal payload. In kilograms, `KGM`, to its decimals: none in `H87`, the piece, three in any other unit.

netWeight.description: Its goods' net weight, the crates' own left out. In kilograms, `KGM`, to its decimals: none in `H87`, the piece, three in any other unit.

grossWeight.description: Its goods' net weight and its crates' own empty weight: what its payload holds. In kilograms, `KGM`, to its decimals: none in `H87`, the piece, three in any other unit.

free.description: What its load leaves of it. Always written.

MaterialDefinition.description: `GET /customer/v1/materials/{material}`: the material and the fields it is configured with, as the customer reads them — what its sales views (MVKE), its configuration profile (CU41), its class (CL02), its characteristics (CT04) and the profile's characteristic groups (`VCH_HL_GRP*`) say before anything is entered. Static: a UI fetches it once per model version.

family.description: The class type 300 the material is configured against: its family.

unit.description: The unit an order of it is in: the unit an entry's quantity is in. Its UN/ECE Recommendation 20 common code — the table in the document's description — with SAP's internal key beside it.

sapUnit.description: SAP's internal key of `unit` (`T006-MSEHI`), which no logon language changes: `ST` for the piece, which SD's English screens print `PC`.

readsSoldToParty.description: Whether the order header's sold-to party reaches the configuration: an entry names one.

salesAreas.description: Where it is sold: its sales views, one sales area each.

fields.description: The characteristics an order can enter — CT04's *Not ready for input* unset — of those the material's screen offers before anything is entered, a field it hides or excludes there, or whose value master data fixes there — the material's classification, or the one value its class allows — left out and an entry on one refused as unknown; and those a printed line bills by (`notReadyForInput` true). In screen order: the profile's groups in their sorting order, then the fields no group names.

MaterialList.description: `GET /customer/v1/materials`: a page of the materials a sales order can configure, as an object holding the list.

next.description: The cursor of the next page, its request's `after`; absent on the last. The order materials is listed in never changes from page to page.

total.description: How many materials the request lists, on every page. A whole number.

MaterialSummary.description: `GET /customer/v1/materials`: one material a sales order can configure.

family.description: The class type 300 the material is configured against: its family.

unit.description: The unit an order of it is in: the unit an entry's quantity is in. Its UN/ECE Recommendation 20 common code — the table in the document's description — with SAP's internal key beside it.

sapUnit.description: SAP's internal key of `unit` (`T006-MSEHI`), which no logon language changes: `ST` for the piece, which SD's English screens print `PC`.

readsSoldToParty.description: Whether the order header's sold-to party reaches the configuration.

salesAreas.description: Where it is sold: its sales views, one sales area each.

quantity.description: The figure. In `unit`, to its decimals: none in `H87`, the piece, three in any other unit.

unit.description: The figure's unit. Its UN/ECE Recommendation 20 common code — the table in the document's description — with SAP's internal key beside it.

sapUnit.description: SAP's internal key of `unit` (`T006-MSEHI`), which no logon language changes: `ST` for the piece, which SD's English screens print `PC`.

Message.description: One message, in the one shape every part of a document carries — the configuration's issues and its lock, the item processing's messages, the pricing analysis' notes and a field's rejection — BAPIRET2's: its severity, its code, whether a buyer needs to look at the line, the text to display, the message's variables where it has them, and what it is about.

severity.description: How bad the message is, as BAPIRET2's `TYPE` says it: `E` an error, `W` a warning, `I` information. Open: a value a later version adds reads as `error`.

code.description:
SAP's message class and number, `CLASS/NNN`, where SAP issues a message for the situation — split it on its last `/`, since a class may hold one — and the engine's documented code otherwise. A situation keeps its code. Open: a code a later version adds is read by its `severity` and `attention`.

| Code | Severity | Attention | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ZSD_AVC/001` | warning | yes | The order quantity is below the item's minimum, the smallest of its packs' (a catalogue article made to length: at least 600): the order quantity's user exit lifted it to that minimum and rounded it up as `ZSD_AVC/002` says. `V1` the quantity entered, `V2` its unit, `V3` the quantity set, `V4` the packs. |
| `ZSD_AVC/002` | warning | no | The order quantity was rounded up by the packs: whole steps of the largest `rounding`, the rest one step of the smallest `rounding` at least as large. `V1` the quantity entered, `V2` its unit, `V3` the quantity set, `V4` the packs. |
| `ZSD_AVC/003` | info | no | The order quantity is packed as entered, the last pack possibly part-full. `V1` the quantity, `V2` its unit, `V3` the packs. |
| `V1/382` | error | yes | Material is not defined for the order's sales organization and distribution channel: it has no sales view there (MM01 *Sales: sales org. 1*), and VA01 creates no such item. The line is refused: not priced, in no group and no net value. |
| `VCH_HL_CORE/038` | error | yes | Upward changes detected: a level below values the configuration so that a selection above it would now go differently. SAP saves no such configuration as released — it must be locked — and the order is not issued as a quotation. |
| `VCH_HL_DEP_TRACE/005` | info | no | Restricted domain of a characteristic by a constraint, as AVC's dependency trace words it: the value is out, the other entries leave it no consistent configuration. `V1` the characteristic, `V2` the constraint; `target.level` the level the constraint is bound on. |
| `REQUIRED_CHARACTERISTIC` | warning | yes | A characteristic the configuration must value has no value: entry required in the class, or a selection condition decidedly true for the values so far. The configuration is incomplete. |
| `MISSING_SELECTION_VALUE` | warning | yes | A class item selects its component by a value not given yet: the level beneath it is not selected. The configuration is incomplete. |
| `CLASS_ITEM_NO_MATCH` | warning | yes | No component classified in a class item's class matches the values: none is selected. The configuration is incomplete. |
| `CLASS_ITEM_AMBIGUOUS` | warning | yes | More than one component classified in a class item's class matches the values: none is selected. The configuration is incomplete. |
| `TABLE_LOOKUP_NO_MATCH` | warning | yes | A class item's selection reads a variant table that holds no row for the values. The configuration is incomplete. |
| `TERM_NO_VALUE` | warning | yes | A class item's selection computes a value from the configuration that has none for the values so far. The configuration is incomplete. |
| `SALES_UNIT_CONVERSION_MISSING` | warning | yes | The order's unit converts to no base unit of the material: no procedure valued the conversion, and the material master holds no such unit. The configuration is incomplete. |
| `INVALID_CHARACTERISTIC_VALUE` | error | yes | A value the characteristic does not take here: off its Values tab, its format or its interval, one holding a control, bidirectional or invisible character, or one the class or a rule leaves out. The configuration is inconsistent. |
| `CONSTRAINT_VIOLATION` | error | yes | The values break a constraint, which the text describes. The configuration is inconsistent. |
| `ASSIGNMENT_CONFLICT` | error | yes | A procedure assigns a characteristic a value other than the one entered. The configuration is inconsistent. |
| `EXCLUDED_REQUIRED` | error | yes | A characteristic is excluded by a precondition and mandatory at once. The configuration is inconsistent. |
| `PRECONDITION_VIOLATION` | error | yes | A characteristic a precondition excludes holds a value. The configuration is inconsistent. |
| `BOM_RECURSION` | error | yes | A class item resolves to a material already above it in the structure. The configuration is inconsistent. |
| `UNKNOWN_MATERIAL` | error | yes | The material is none a sales order configures, or, answered alike, one sold in no sales area the sign-in acts in for one of its customers — the one-time customer's for a sign-in linked to none — the inquiry's material aside. The line is refused: not priced, in no group and no net value. |
| `UNKNOWN_CHARACTERISTIC` | error | yes | A value names a characteristic the material's class does not allocate, or one an order cannot enter. The line is refused: not priced, in no group and no net value. |
| `MATERIAL_BLOCKED` | warning | no | An item's material's sales status in the order's sales area (TVMS through `MVKE-VMSTA`) blocks a kind of sales document — an inquiry profile quotations, a profile the plant makes inquiries — that other items of the order are not blocked for: the materials split the document, and the order is not issued as it, `issuableAs` leaving it out. On the order, one per blocked item, `target.item` its number; `params` the material, its sales status, the status's text and the document it is blocked for, `quotation` or `inquiry` — kept in the summary view too, and left out with its line where `only` drops the line. An order whose every item is blocked alike carries none, its `issuableAs` saying so. |
| `NEW_DIE_DEPOSIT` | info | no | The items are profiles whose die is still to be made — their material's sales status in the order's sales area keeps them from a quotation, the inquiry's — and any new geometry requires a refundable deposit per die, outside the net value, as the inquiry's page says under its totals. On the order, once, where the items name a die; kept with its `params` in the summary view too: `V1` the deposit per die, `V2` its currency, `V3` the dies the items name, each counted once (since 1.3.0). |
| `NO_PRICING_PROCEDURE` | warning | yes | The item's sales area determines no pricing procedure: the item is not priced. |
| `CONDITION_RECORD_MISSING` | warning | yes | A variant key the configuration set has no condition record valid on the pricing date: the pricing analysis' "condition record is missing", and SD prices on without it. |
| `UNIT_MISMATCH` | warning | yes | A condition record is per a unit the item's quantity does not convert to: its line is not priced. |
| `BASIS_MISSING` | warning | yes | A condition finds no basis on the item to price on — a quantity the configuration has yet to value: its line is not priced. |

attention.description: Whether a buyer needs to look at the line the message is on, set per code by the table under `code`: every error, and an order quantity lifted to a minimum, `ZSD_AVC/001`; not a quantity rounded up (`ZSD_AVC/002`) or packed as entered (`003`).

text.description: The message's words, for display, in the line's commercial units: a fact a reader acts on is a field of its own.

params.description: The message's variables, `MESSAGE_V1` to `MESSAGE_V4` in order, as the message was filled; absent where it has none.

target.description: What the message is about, by key and never by a place in a list: each member where the message is about one, none on a message about the item of a screen alone.

item.description: The order's item, `VBAP-POSNR`: the line's place 10, 20, 30 while a request numbers no line.

level.description: The configuration's level, by its material.

characteristic.description: The characteristic, by its CT04 name.

field.description: BAPIRET2's `FIELD`: a field of the line, by its name in the request. Reserved: no message names one yet.

NetPrice.description: A line's net price, `VBAP-NETPR` per `KPEIN` `KMEIN`: its net value over its order quantity — derived; the net value binds.

amount.description: The price. In the document currency, to its decimals: two in `EUR`.

per.description: How many of `unit` it is for: 1 today, the price being the net value over the order quantity. At the precision the engine computed it, in its shortest digits.

unit.description: The unit it is per. Its UN/ECE Recommendation 20 common code — the table in the document's description — with SAP's internal key beside it.

sapUnit.description: SAP's internal key of `unit` (`T006-MSEHI`), which no logon language changes: `ST` for the piece, which SD's English screens print `PC`.

Only.description: Which lines the summary carries: `all` of them, the default; those that need a look, `attention` — a status not `ok`, or a message marked `attention`; or the `problems`, a status not `ok`. The detail view takes `all` alone, its lines being those `detailItems` names: another is `INVALID_REQUEST` at `/only`. The totals, the groups and both hashes cover the whole order whatever it is.

OrderDocument.description: `POST /customer/v1/order`: the order evaluated as SAP's sales order simulation evaluates it — every line configured, exploded and run through the user exits, the document priced as one, a group condition reading over every line — at the head its status, what it can be issued as, both hashes, its totals, the minimum groups and its own messages, then its lines in the body's order, as `only` and `view` select them. The totals, the groups and both hashes cover the whole order whatever lines are answered. `inputHash` (`h1:` and SHA-256) is a digest of the order as normalized — the sold-to party, the sales area, the references, every line by its number with its customer's fields, material, values (an empty one dropped) and quantity in its unit — and `priceHash` (`p1:`) of each line's number, order quantity and net value and the order's net value: issuing is held to both.

status.description: The worst of all its lines' statuses, a refused line's too.

issuableAs.description: The documents its lines allow: none unless `status` is `ok`, none where a line must be locked (`VCH_HL_CORE/038`), and neither a line's material's sales status blocks (TVMS through `MVKE-VMSTA`). An inquiry issues only an order evaluated with its `customerReference` and each line's `customerMaterial`, which `inputHash` covers.

inputHash.description: `h1:` and the SHA-256 of the order as normalized.

priceHash.description: `p1:` and the SHA-256 of each line's number, order quantity and net value and the order's net value.

groups.description: The minimum groups that lift the order's lines.

messages.description: What the order says as a whole: where the materials' sales status splits a document — some items blocked for it, not all — a `MATERIAL_BLOCKED` per blocked item, `target.item` its number, `params` the material, its sales status, the status's text and the document it is blocked for (`quotation`, `inquiry`), in either view; one on a line `only` leaves out is left out with it.

items.description: The lines `only` and `view` select, in the body's order.

OrderGroup.description: A minimum per order the order's lines are lifted to: SAP's `AMIW`, a statistical group condition holding a minimum over the lines that share it — a colour's powder (`ZPNM`), a die's press run and wear (`ZPDM`, `ZTLM`), the order's anodizing (`ZANM`) — where what the lines bill themselves falls short of it. Only a group that lifts its lines is answered.

id.description: Opaque, unique in the answer: the lines name the group by it. `g1`, `g2` in the order the groups first come — never parse it.

conditionType.description: The minimum's condition type (V/06): the natural key's first half.

key.description: What the group's lines share, the natural key's second half: the die (`609999`), the colour (`RAL 9016 SMOOTH_GLOSS CL1`) — the group key routine's key — or, where the routine keys none, the condition record's table key the lines were found on, or its variant key (`ANODIZING`).

value.description: What the group's lines bill themselves, each its rate over its basis. In the document currency, to its decimals: two in `EUR`.

minimum.description: The minimum, the condition record's amount. In the document currency, to its decimals: two in `EUR`.

uplift.description: What the lines are lifted by: the minimum less `value`, the members' shares summed. In the document currency, to its decimals: two in `EUR`.

OrderHeader.description: The order header as the order was evaluated under it (`VBAK`): the sold-to party (`VBAK-KUNNR`) where given, the sales area (`VBAK-VKORG`, `-VTWEG`) with its text and the division (`VBAK-SPART`), the document currency (`VBAK-WAERK`), the pricing date (`VBKD-PRSDT`) — the day of the evaluation in the sales organization's time zone, which it names — the Incoterms (`VBKD-INCO1`, `-INCO2_L`), and the customer's reference (`VBKD-BSTKD`) and the document's own (`VBAK-XBLNR`) where given. A document issued before the division and the Incoterms were answered lacks them.

soldToParty.description: `VBAK-KUNNR`, as the body gave it, one of digits alone with its leading zeros.

division.description: `VBAK-SPART`, the division OVKK determined the order's pricing by — the items' materials' (`MARA-SPART`), the sales area's third key: `20` LINKIN's industrial profiles, `10` PROFILINK's catalogue. Absent where none was determined: no line priced, or a material in no division.

currency.description: ISO 4217: every amount of the document is in it. Absent where the sales area runs no pricing procedure.

pricingDate.description: `YYYY-MM-DD`: the day of the evaluation in `timeZone`.

timeZone.description: The IANA time zone `pricingDate` is the day in: the sales organization's address's, `Europe/Sofia` for both today.

OrderItem.description: The sales order item as its processing left it.

quantity.description: The quantity the user exits left: lifted to its minimum and rounded up by its packs, as `list_assortment` says; a pack's `pieces` never moves it. In `unit`, to its decimals: none in `H87`, the piece, three in any other unit.

unit.description: The item's unit. Its UN/ECE Recommendation 20 common code — the table in the document's description — with SAP's internal key beside it.

sapUnit.description: SAP's internal key of `unit` (`T006-MSEHI`), which no logon language changes: `ST` for the piece, which SD's English screens print `PC`.

netWeight.description: `VBAP-NTGEW`, theoretical: the profile's weight per metre (an inquiry's, its entered estimate) times its length and `quantity`, computed, not weighed. The net value binds, not the weight. In `weightUnit`, to its decimals: none in `H87`, the piece, three in any other unit.

grossWeight.description: `VBAP-BRGEW`, theoretical as `netWeight`. In `weightUnit`, to its decimals: none in `H87`, the piece, three in any other unit.

weightUnit.description: The weights' unit. Its UN/ECE Recommendation 20 common code — the table in the document's description — with SAP's internal key beside it.

weightSapUnit.description: SAP's internal key of `weightUnit` (`T006-MSEHI`), which no logon language changes: `ST` for the piece, which SD's English screens print `PC`.

messages.description: What the user exits said on the item: the order quantity's names the packs it packed the item in, `6 x AW1, 1 x AW1/2`, whether it changed the quantity or not.

salesText.description: The material's sales text for the item's sales area (MM01 Sales text, MVKE), which SD copies into the item and its output prints beneath it; absent where the material has none.

customerReference.description: `VBKD-BSTKD` on the item, the customer's reference for this line, as the order gave it; absent where none was.

OrderItemRequest.description: `POST /customer/v1/order`: one item of the order, a configuration of a sold material, under the number the caller gives it or its place.

item.description: `VBAP-POSNR`, the item's number: 1 to 6 digits, its leading zeros dropped (`000010` is `10`), each once, never zero. Every item numbers itself or none does — a mix is `INVALID_REQUEST` — and where none does they are 10, 20, 30 by their place. Lines, messages and groups name the item by it.

customerItem.description: `VBAP-POSEX`, the customer's purchase order item: at most 6 characters, echoed on the line. It holds no control, bidirectional or invisible character, Unicode 17.0.0's default-ignorable code points among them but ZWNJ, ZWJ and the variation selectors: those the pattern names, and U+1BCA0 to U+1BCA3, U+1D173 to U+1D17A, U+E0000 to U+E00FF and U+E01F0 to U+E0FFF, beyond U+FFFF. Its length is counted in UTF-16 code units, as SAP counts a CHAR field: a character beyond U+FFFF counts two.

customerMaterial.description: `VBAP-KDMAT`, the customer's own name or number for the material: at most 35 characters, echoed on the line; an inquiry's row is titled by it. It holds no control, bidirectional or invisible character, Unicode 17.0.0's default-ignorable code points among them but ZWNJ, ZWJ and the variation selectors: those the pattern names, and U+1BCA0 to U+1BCA3, U+1D173 to U+1D17A, U+E0000 to U+E00FF and U+E01F0 to U+E0FFF, beyond U+FFFF. Its length is counted in UTF-16 code units, as SAP counts a CHAR field: a character beyond U+FFFF counts two.

material.description: A material a sales order configures; any other is refused on its line, `UNKNOWN_MATERIAL`.

values.description: The entered values by CT04 name, as the user typed or picked them; a name the class does not allocate, or an order cannot enter, refuses the line, `UNKNOWN_CHARACTERISTIC`. A value is a string, or a number, read as its text.

quantity.description: The order quantity, in the material's unit: required on every line. A JSON number, positive, of at most its unit's decimals — none in `H87`, the piece: a string is refused, `INVALID_REQUEST`, and more decimals or a quantity not above zero `INVALID_QUANTITY`, each with its `pointer`.

unit.description: The unit `quantity` is in: the Rec 20 code of the material's own unit, `MaterialSummary.unit` — `H87` for the piece — the one unit an entry takes; the material's where omitted. Any other code, SAP's `PC` and `ST` among them, is refused, `INVALID_REQUEST`, with its `pointer`.

customerReference.description: `VBKD-BSTKD` on the item, the customer's reference for this line — VA21's item Purchase order data: at most 35 characters, printed on the quotation's row as given. It holds no control, bidirectional or invisible character, Unicode 17.0.0's default-ignorable code points among them but ZWNJ, ZWJ and the variation selectors: those the pattern names, and U+1BCA0 to U+1BCA3, U+1D173 to U+1D17A, U+E0000 to U+E00FF and U+E01F0 to U+E0FFF, beyond U+FFFF. Its length is counted in UTF-16 code units, as SAP counts a CHAR field: a character beyond U+FFFF counts two.

OrderLine.description: One line of the order, `VBAP`, keyed by its `item`: in the summary view the compact row of its decision facts, at most 900 bytes besides the customer's fields it echoes, an inconsistent line's up to 2,000 with the messages its refused values and its pricing leave; in the detail view, as the quotation prints it, its description, its specification in a line and in rows, the values it entered, its bill by process with each charge, its shares of the minimum groups and every message beside them, at most 8 KB. A refused line carries its number, its customer's fields, its material, its status and why.

customerReference.description: `VBKD-BSTKD` on the item, as the body gave it.

text.description: Detail: the specification in one short line, the product's own values, then the first value of each further step, each value once, the geometry with its description: `7099999 · Window frame · T5, standard · 4500 mm · Powder coated`. The rows the quotation prints are `specification`.

packs.description: The packs the user exit packed the line in; empty where it packs none.

stockBars.description: What the line takes from stock: a list, not availability; empty where it is pressed to order.

netValue.description: `VBAP-NETWR`, the binding figure; absent on a line not priced. In the document currency, to its decimals: two in `EUR`.

uplift.description: The line's share of the uplifts of the minimum groups it shares, in its net value: what they lift it by. Absent on a line not priced. In the document currency, to its decimals: two in `EUR`.

groups.description: The `id`s of the minimum groups the line shares.

missing.description: The characteristics the line must value and has not, by CT04 name; in the summary they stand for the incompleteness they cause.

messages.description: In the summary the line's warnings and errors without their variables, but what `missing` says — a `REQUIRED_CHARACTERISTIC` on the name of a field it names, on the root or a level below, and `MISSING_SELECTION_VALUE` — and `BASIS_MISSING`, a basis waiting on those values; in the detail every message with its variables. A customer's line leaves out the first two in either view while `missing` names a field or a field's entry is refused for its value (`INVALID_CHARACTERISTIC_VALUE`).

values.description: Detail: the values the order entered, by CT04 name — what a repeat of the line sends back as its `values`.

specification.description: Detail: the specification as the quotation prints it.

breakdown.description: Detail: the bill by process, each with its charges; the processes' values sum to `netValue`.

shares.description: Detail: the line's part of each minimum group it shares.

salesText.description: Detail: the material's sales text for the sales area (MM01 Sales text, `MVKE`).

OrderRequest.description: `POST /customer/v1/order`: the body — the header's sales area, sold-to party and references, which lines the answer carries and how, and the items.

salesOrganization.description: `VBAK-VKORG`, required with the distribution channel: an item whose material is not sold there is refused on its line, `V1/382` where it is sold in another sales area the sign-in acts in, `UNKNOWN_MATERIAL` where in none, the inquiry's material aside.

soldToParty.description: `VBAK-KUNNR`, the order header's sold-to party, one for every item: a customer number of at most 10 characters, digits alone read with their leading zeros (`9999999` is `0009999999`), one the customer master holds and extends to the sales area, else `UNKNOWN_SOLD_TO_PARTY`. It holds no control, bidirectional or invisible character, Unicode 17.0.0's default-ignorable code points among them but ZWNJ, ZWJ and the variation selectors: those the pattern names, and U+1BCA0 to U+1BCA3, U+1D173 to U+1D17A, U+E0000 to U+E00FF and U+E01F0 to U+E0FFF, beyond U+FFFF. Its length is counted in UTF-16 code units, as SAP counts a CHAR field: a character beyond U+FFFF counts two.

customerReference.description: `VBKD-BSTKD`, the customer's reference for the document, its Cust. reference: at most 35 characters, printed on the issued document as given. It holds no control, bidirectional or invisible character, Unicode 17.0.0's default-ignorable code points among them but ZWNJ, ZWJ and the variation selectors: those the pattern names, and U+1BCA0 to U+1BCA3, U+1D173 to U+1D17A, U+E0000 to U+E00FF and U+E01F0 to U+E0FFF, beyond U+FFFF. Its length is counted in UTF-16 code units, as SAP counts a CHAR field: a character beyond U+FFFF counts two.

reference.description: `VBAK-XBLNR`, the document's own reference: at most 16 characters, printed on the issued document as its reference. It holds no control, bidirectional or invisible character, Unicode 17.0.0's default-ignorable code points among them but ZWNJ, ZWJ and the variation selectors: those the pattern names, and U+1BCA0 to U+1BCA3, U+1D173 to U+1D17A, U+E0000 to U+E00FF and U+E01F0 to U+E0FFF, beyond U+FFFF. Its length is counted in UTF-16 code units, as SAP counts a CHAR field: a character beyond U+FFFF counts two.

detailItems.description: The lines the detail view answers, by their `item`: 1 to 20, with `view` `detail` alone, each one of the order's — else `INVALID_REQUEST` with its `pointer`; more is `TOO_MANY_ITEMS`. The detail view needs them.

items.description: At least one, at most 300: more is `TOO_MANY_ITEMS`.

OrderTotals.description: The order's totals, whatever lines the answer carries: its net value, `VBAK-NETWR`, the lines not refused summed, and its lines counted.

netValue.description: The order's net value, net of VAT, ex works. In the document currency, to its decimals: two in `EUR`.

PriceTier.description: One interval of a graduated scale a line's basis reached.

from.description: Where the interval starts: in `unit` and to its decimals, or in `currency`'s on a value scale.

quantity.description: How much of the basis fell in the interval: in `unit` and to its decimals, or in `currency`'s on a value scale.

amount.description: The rate for the interval: an amount in the line's currency, to its decimals, or, on a percentage, the percentage at the precision the engine computed it.

unit.description: The unit the scale is read in: the item's, or kilograms; absent on a value scale, which `currency` names. Its UN/ECE Recommendation 20 common code — the table in the document's description — with SAP's internal key beside it.

sapUnit.description: SAP's internal key of `unit` (`T006-MSEHI`), which no logon language changes: `ST` for the piece, which SD's English screens print `PC`.

currency.description: The currency a value scale is read in, ISO 4217.

PricedLine.description: One line of the pricing, the way the sales order's Conditions tab shows it: the step of the pricing procedure, the condition type — absent on a subtotal — the variant key the configuration set where the line is a variant condition, the record's rate, the basis it applied to, the pricing factor the configuration carried, and the value. A statistical line informs and does not count toward the net value.

description.description: The condition type's text, or the subtotal's.

variantKeyText.description: The key's text (VK30), for the reader — or, on a line an access sequence found, the text of its table key's value.

access.description: The access of the condition type's access sequence that found the record (`KOMV-KOLNR`), where one did.

variableKey.description: The condition table's key values the record was found under (`VAKEY`), where an access found it.

amount.description: The record's rate (`KBETR`); absent on a subtotal and on a percentage, whose rate is `percentage`. In the document currency, to its decimals: two in `EUR`.

currency.description: The rate's currency, ISO 4217; absent on a percentage.

percentage.description: The rate of a percentage condition (calculation type `A`), in percent of `basis`: `3.5` is 3.5 %. `amount` and `currency` are absent beside it. At the precision the engine computed it, in its shortest digits.

per.description: The quantity the rate is per. At the precision the engine computed it, in its shortest digits.

unit.description: The unit the rate is per. Its UN/ECE Recommendation 20 common code — the table in the document's description — with SAP's internal key beside it.

sapUnit.description: SAP's internal key of `unit` (`T006-MSEHI`), which no logon language changes: `ST` for the piece, which SD's English screens print `PC`.

basis.description: The basis the rate applied to (`KAWRT`): in `basisUnit` and to its decimals, or, without one, an amount in the document currency to its decimals — a percentage's base value, a fixed amount's 1.

basisUnit.description: The basis's unit. Its UN/ECE Recommendation 20 common code — the table in the document's description — with SAP's internal key beside it.

basisSapUnit.description: SAP's internal key of `basisUnit` (`T006-MSEHI`), which no logon language changes: `ST` for the piece, which SD's English screens print `PC`.

factor.description: The pricing factor the configuration carried. At the precision the engine computed it, in its shortest digits.

factorOf.description: What the factor is, for the reader: the characteristic the procedure took it from, or the characteristic over a number where the rate is per so many of its units — `ZA_METAL_KG / 1000`, the billed weight in tonnes.

minimum.description: Whether the line bills a minimum: its factor is the tariff's minimum billable quantity, or a formula lifted its value to a minimum. False where the line is the order's own usage.

group.description: The order's side of the line: on a group condition, the basis the record was read on summed over the items of the document that share it, its unit, and how many items they are; on a line a formula lifted to a group condition's share, that group's. Absent on a line priced from the item alone.

basis.description: The basis summed over the group: in `unit` and to its decimals, or in `currency`'s for a basis of value.

unit.description: The basis's unit; absent on a basis of value, which `currency` names. Its UN/ECE Recommendation 20 common code — the table in the document's description — with SAP's internal key beside it.

sapUnit.description: SAP's internal key of `unit` (`T006-MSEHI`), which no logon language changes: `ST` for the piece, which SD's English screens print `PC`.

currency.description: The currency a basis of value is in, ISO 4217.

valueBy.description: Where a condition value formula set the line's value: the formula's own account of it, with the numbers it used. A bill prints it in place of the rate text.

tiers.description: On a graduated scale, the intervals the basis fell in.

value.description: The line's value (`KWERT`). In the document currency, to its decimals: two in `EUR`.

from.description: On a subtotal, the first step it sums.

to.description: On a subtotal, the last step it sums.

print.description: V/08's print indicator (`T683S-DRUKZ`), SAP's own codes: whether the line appears on the customer's documents, and when — `A` to `D` in the totals and `a` to `d` in the item: `A` and `a` always, `B` and `b` where the value is not zero, `C` and `c` where it differs from the line before, `D` and `d` where both hold; `X` at item level and `S` in the totals block are SAP's previous scheme, which a procedure never mixes with these. Absent, the line is internal. A reader prints a line whose code it does not know, so no charge is hidden from a bill. Open: a value a later version adds reads as `X`.

Process.description: A process of an item's bill, as V/08's printed subtotals group its conditions — the extrusion, the coating, the cut — keyed by its subtotal's V/08 step: its text and value, whether a line adding to it bills a minimum or the order's share, and in the detail its charges. A printed line outside every subtotal is a process of its own, its one charge itself.

step.description: The subtotal's V/08 step, `STUNR`; a line outside every subtotal its own.

value.description: The subtotal. In the document currency, to its decimals: two in `EUR`.

minimum.description: Whether a line adding to it bills a minimum.

perOrder.description: Whether a line adding to it is the item's share of an amount for the whole order.

charges.description: Its charges, in the bill's order.

QuotationHistory.description: `GET /customer/v1/quotations`: a page of the customer's quotations, newest first.

next.description: The cursor of the next page, for `after`; absent on the last.

QuotationLink.description: `POST /customer/v1/quotations` and `POST /customer/v1/inquiries`: the document issued; `POST /customer/v1/quotations/{id}/submit`: the quotation submitted; and `POST …/{id}/revoke`, either kind: the document revoked — its number, its id and where it stands, its page's URL, the day it was priced on, its net value and currency, the hashes it was issued under and the customer's reference, and, revoked, the day and why.

number.description: LINKIN's own number for it, ten characters: `LQ26000000` a quotation's, `LI26000000` an inquiry's — the prefix, the last two digits of the year it was priced in and six of its sequence; never the page's id.

id.description: The page's id, 32 hex digits, which `url` ends in: what `GET /customer/v1/quotations/{id}/document`, or the inquiry's, reads the document by.

status.description: Where it stands now. As issued, a quotation `draft`, not binding until LINKIN releases it; an inquiry `open`. A quotation its customer submitted, `submitted`.

url.description: Where its summary page opens. A customer's document's: the page's absolute URL on LINKIN's API, `GET /customer/v1/quotations/{id}` or the inquiry's.

issuedOn.description: `YYYY-MM-DD`: the pricing date it was issued on.

netValue.description: The document's net value. In the document currency, to its decimals: two in `EUR`.

revokedOn.description: `YYYY-MM-DD`: the day it was revoked, where it was — by its customer, in the sales organization's zone; by LINKIN, before 2.0.0, in UTC.

revocation.description: Why it was revoked, where it was: its customer's reason.

QuotationRequest.description: `POST /customer/v1/quotations`: `POST /customer/v1/order`'s body but for what its answer carries — `only`, `view` and `detailItems`, each refused here, `INVALID_REQUEST`, since issuing answers no order — and the hashes the order was shown with, required.

salesOrganization.description: `VBAK-VKORG`, required with the distribution channel: an item whose material is not sold there is refused on its line, `V1/382` where it is sold in another sales area the sign-in acts in, `UNKNOWN_MATERIAL` where in none, the inquiry's material aside.

soldToParty.description: `VBAK-KUNNR`, the order header's sold-to party, one for every item: a customer number of at most 10 characters, digits alone read with their leading zeros (`9999999` is `0009999999`), one the customer master holds and extends to the sales area, else `UNKNOWN_SOLD_TO_PARTY`. It holds no control, bidirectional or invisible character, Unicode 17.0.0's default-ignorable code points among them but ZWNJ, ZWJ and the variation selectors: those the pattern names, and U+1BCA0 to U+1BCA3, U+1D173 to U+1D17A, U+E0000 to U+E00FF and U+E01F0 to U+E0FFF, beyond U+FFFF. Its length is counted in UTF-16 code units, as SAP counts a CHAR field: a character beyond U+FFFF counts two.

customerReference.description: `VBKD-BSTKD`, the customer's reference for the document, its Cust. reference: at most 35 characters, printed on the issued document as given. It holds no control, bidirectional or invisible character, Unicode 17.0.0's default-ignorable code points among them but ZWNJ, ZWJ and the variation selectors: those the pattern names, and U+1BCA0 to U+1BCA3, U+1D173 to U+1D17A, U+E0000 to U+E00FF and U+E01F0 to U+E0FFF, beyond U+FFFF. Its length is counted in UTF-16 code units, as SAP counts a CHAR field: a character beyond U+FFFF counts two.

reference.description: `VBAK-XBLNR`, the document's own reference: at most 16 characters, printed on the issued document as its reference. It holds no control, bidirectional or invisible character, Unicode 17.0.0's default-ignorable code points among them but ZWNJ, ZWJ and the variation selectors: those the pattern names, and U+1BCA0 to U+1BCA3, U+1D173 to U+1D17A, U+E0000 to U+E00FF and U+E01F0 to U+E0FFF, beyond U+FFFF. Its length is counted in UTF-16 code units, as SAP counts a CHAR field: a character beyond U+FFFF counts two.

items.description: At least one, at most 300: more is `TOO_MANY_ITEMS`.

RejectionReason.description:
The reason a customer revokes its document for: LINKIN's reasons for rejection, SAP's `VBAP-ABGRU` (OVAG), each by its code, every one for a quotation and an inquiry alike —

- `Z1`: Revised: replaced by a new version
- `Z2`: Price too high
- `Z3`: Ordered from another supplier
- `Z4`: Project cancelled or postponed
- `Z5`: Die or minimum-order costs too high
- `Z6`: Lead time or LINKIN's review too long
- `Z7`: Ordered from LINKIN another way
- `Z8`: Waiting for a lower metal (LME) price
- `Z9`: Issued by mistake or duplicate
- `ZZ`: Other (see note) — `note` then required.

Revocation.description: Why a document was revoked, as its customer gave it: the reason, by its code and its text — SAP's reason for rejection, `VBAP-ABGRU` and `TVAGT-BEZEI`, the text as LINKIN kept it on the day — and the note, in the giver's own words. A document LINKIN revoked, before 2.0.0, carries none.

note.description: The note, as given; absent where none was.

RevocationReason.description: The reason a customer revoked its document for, by its code (`RejectionReason`), its text beside it: a code a later version adds is read as other. Open: a value a later version adds reads as `ZZ`.

RevocationRequest.description: `POST /customer/v1/quotations/{id}/revoke` and the inquiry's: the body — the sold-to party and the sales area the document was issued to, as a submission's, another party's or area's the `404` of an unknown document; why the customer revokes it, by its reason's code; and its note.

soldToParty.description: `VBAK-KUNNR`, the customer the document was issued to: a customer number of at most 10 characters, digits alone read with their leading zeros (`9999999` is `0009999999`). It holds no control, bidirectional or invisible character, Unicode 17.0.0's default-ignorable code points among them but ZWNJ, ZWJ and the variation selectors: those the pattern names, and U+1BCA0 to U+1BCA3, U+1D173 to U+1D17A, U+E0000 to U+E00FF and U+E01F0 to U+E0FFF, beyond U+FFFF. Its length is counted in UTF-16 code units, as SAP counts a CHAR field: a character beyond U+FFFF counts two.

salesOrganization.description: `VBAK-VKORG` of the sales area it was issued in, required with the distribution channel.

distributionChannel.description: `VBAK-VTWEG` of the sales area it was issued in, required with the sales organization.

note.description: The customer's note, in its own words: why it revokes the document, beside the reason. Required with `ZZ`, other; optional with any other reason, an empty one none. One line of the document's header text in SAP (text object `VBBK`), at most 132 characters. It holds no control, bidirectional or invisible character, Unicode 17.0.0's default-ignorable code points among them but ZWNJ, ZWJ and the variation selectors: those the pattern names, and U+1BCA0 to U+1BCA3, U+1D173 to U+1D17A, U+E0000 to U+E00FF and U+E01F0 to U+E0FFF, beyond U+FFFF. Its length is counted in UTF-16 code units, as SAP counts a CHAR field: a character beyond U+FFFF counts two.

SalesAreaSummary.description: A sales area a material is sold in — the sales organization with its text, and the distribution channel: the material's sales view (MM01 Sales: sales org. 1). An order carries one, and every item of it is a material sold there.

SmallerCarrier.description: A carrier smaller than a crate's own, and the height all the crate's packs would stand in it, every line it holds, bands floor up, each band lying there whichever way round stands lower for its packs, that carrier's full count the way it holds the most, the face as measured where both hold as many: always above that carrier's `insideHeight` in the plan's `carriers`, or absent where a pack of the crate fits no row across it.

carrier.description: The carrier, by the planner's own name: `AW1/3`, `AW1/2`.

height.description: The height, in millimetres, to hundredths; absent where no row takes a pack.

SpecificationRow.description: One row of an item's specification as the quotation prints it: a characteristic's name over its value, every step of the screen alike — the product's, a finish, a thermal break's second side, the machining — each characteristic a row of its own, named by its heading where it has one (`FieldState.heading`), else by its description (`text`); a flag by that name over its *Yes*.

value.description: The value in words, with its unit; the geometry's with its description, `7099999 · Window frame`.

StockBar.description: A bar or piece the line is cut from stock rather than pressed for it: a material variant a class item of the structure resolved to. A list of what the structure takes from stock, not availability.

bomItem.description: `STPO-POSNR`, the BOM item that holds it.

stage.description: The stage whose BOM that is, by its material.

SubmissionRequest.description: `POST /customer/v1/quotations/{id}/submit`: the body — the sold-to party and the sales area the quotation was issued to. Another party's or area's is the `404` of an unknown quotation.

soldToParty.description: `VBAK-KUNNR`, the customer the quotation was issued to: a customer number of at most 10 characters, digits alone read with their leading zeros (`9999999` is `0009999999`). It holds no control, bidirectional or invisible character, Unicode 17.0.0's default-ignorable code points among them but ZWNJ, ZWJ and the variation selectors: those the pattern names, and U+1BCA0 to U+1BCA3, U+1D173 to U+1D17A, U+E0000 to U+E00FF and U+E01F0 to U+E0FFF, beyond U+FFFF. Its length is counted in UTF-16 code units, as SAP counts a CHAR field: a character beyond U+FFFF counts two.

salesOrganization.description: `VBAK-VKORG` of the sales area it was issued in, required with the distribution channel.

distributionChannel.description: `VBAK-VTWEG` of the sales area it was issued in, required with the sales organization.

TariffCondition.description: One condition type (V/06) of a process with every rate recorded for it in the sales area: one meter of the price list.

step.description: The step of the pricing procedure (V/08).

perOrder.description: A group condition: charged once per order for the items that share it, spread over them.

statistical.description: A statistical step: the line informs and is not charged itself — a minimum another line is billed at the least of.

scaleType.description: Where the records carry scales (`T685A-STFKZ`): `A` a from-scale, `D` a graduated-to interval scale. `A` is the type SAP sets where none is chosen. Open: a value a later version adds reads as `A`.

TariffDocument.description: `GET /customer/v1/tariff`: the price list of a customer's sales area — the pricing procedure it runs (OVKK), one process per block, one meter per condition type, one rate per record — as the customer reads it.

TariffFactor.description: What a rate is multiplied by: the billed quantity the configuration hands SD as a pricing factor (`$SET_PRICING_FACTOR`).

characteristic.description: The CT04 name of the characteristic the factor is read from.

text.description: `CHARC_TXT`: the characteristic's description, or its name where it has none — what the quantity is.

unit.description: The characteristic's unit. Its UN/ECE Recommendation 20 common code — the table in the document's description — with SAP's internal key beside it.

sapUnit.description: SAP's internal key of `unit` (`T006-MSEHI`), which no logon language changes: `ST` for the piece, which SD's English screens print `PC`.

per.description: How many of `unit` the factor counts as one, where the procedure divides the characteristic — the billed weight in tonnes, `ZA_METAL_KG / 1000`: the rate is per 1,000 kg. Absent where the factor is the characteristic itself. At the precision the engine computed it, in its shortest digits.

minimum.description: The least the quantity is billed at, where a procedure line fixes a minimum in place of the order's own quantity; a count without a unit as the line states it. In `unit`, to its decimals: none in `H87`, the piece, three in any other unit.

TariffProcess.description: One process of the price list: a block of the pricing procedure closed by its subtotal, what a bill groups by.

step.description: The subtotal step that closes the block (V/08).

TariffRate.description: One rate of the price list: a condition record (VK11) as the customer reads it — what it is found under, the amount, what the amount is multiplied by.

variantKey.description: The variant key the record is read on; absent on a record filed under its condition table's other key fields, which `variableKey` carries, or under the sales area alone.

variantKeyText.description: The key's text (VK30), or, on a record filed under its condition table's other key fields, each key value's Values-tab text.

variableKey.description: The key values the record is filed under in its condition table (`VAKEY`) beyond the sales area and the variant key; absent where there are none, as on a record read on a variant key.

amount.description: The record's amount; absent on a percentage, whose rate is `percentage`. In the document currency, to its decimals: two in `EUR`.

currency.description: The rate's currency, ISO 4217; absent on a percentage.

percentage.description: The rate of a percentage condition (calculation type `A`), in percent. `amount` and `currency` are absent beside it. At the precision the engine computed it, in its shortest digits.

per.description: The record's pricing unit quantity: 1,000 for a rate per tonne — or, on a fixed amount the step's value formula multiplies by a quantity, 1 of that quantity's unit. At the precision the engine computed it, in its shortest digits.

unit.description: The pricing unit: `KGM`, `H87`, or the unit of the quantity a value formula multiplies a fixed amount by, `MTR`. Absent where the factor carries the quantity. Its UN/ECE Recommendation 20 common code — the table in the document's description — with SAP's internal key beside it.

sapUnit.description: SAP's internal key of `unit` (`T006-MSEHI`), which no logon language changes: `ST` for the piece, which SD's English screens print `PC`.

scale.description: The record's scale, where it has one, ascending by `from`.

TariffScaleLine.description: One line of a condition record's scale: from this basis on, this amount.

from.description: The scale basis the line starts at: in the rate's unit and to its decimals, or in the currency's on a value scale.

amount.description: The rate from `from` on: an amount in the rate's currency, to its decimals, or a percentage at the precision the engine computed it.

ToSaveATruck.description: What one truck fewer would need of the order, at the least: by the bound's weight and space, each one truck fewer cannot hold, how much. Each part is necessary, never enough: an order so much smaller may still need the trucks, and only a new plan shows it. Each holds for any order so much lighter or smaller, its crates made again or not. A part is absent where its term already allows one truck fewer, `smaller` under a tenth too. Long crates give no part: an order whose crates are as many and as long, but lower, may take one truck fewer.

lighter.description: The gross weight, the goods' and the crates' own, above one truck fewer's payloads: the order at least so much lighter. In kilograms, `KGM`, to its decimals: none in `H87`, the piece, three in any other unit.

smaller.description: The space the crates take, as each truck's `fill.space` counts it, above one truck fewer's: the order at least so much smaller, as a share of one truck's space. In percent, to one decimal, rounded down; absent where that is under a tenth.

TruckFill.description: How much of a truck its load takes: of its floor, its inside's volume, its payload and its space.

floor.description: The floor its stacks stand on. In percent, to one decimal.

volume.description: The inside its crates fill. In percent, to one decimal.

weight.description: The payload its weight takes, its goods' and its crates' own. In percent, to one decimal.

space.description: The space its crates take, as the plan's bound counts it: their length times height against the lanes the truck holds across, its inside length and its stack height (`stackHeight`). It is not the inside's volume, `volume`. In percent, to one decimal, rounded down, so 100 only when full.

TruckFree.description: What a truck's load leaves of it, to compare plans by: the payload less its gross weight, and each lane's length no crate stands on. Neither says what more fits. A crate needs a lane as wide as it and its own length in one piece, or a crate of its width at least as long to stand on, flush with its front end, no higher than the truck's stacks stand, and weighs its goods and its own empty weight.

payloadLessGrossWeight.description: The legal payload less the truck's gross weight, its goods' and its crates' own. In kilograms, `KGM`, to its decimals: none in `H87`, the piece, three in any other unit.

unusedLaneLengths.description: Lane by lane from the left side, every lane as wide as the plan's widest crate the truck holds across, the length along it, front to back, no crate stands on: an empty lane its inside length. In whole millimetres.

TruckInside.description: A truck's inside, in whole millimetres: along it, across it and up, and how high its stacks stand.

stackHeight.description: The most a stack of crates stands, a margin under the roof: about four full crates high.

ValueHelpList.description: `POST /customer/v1/value-help`: a page of the characteristic's list, every value it can take with whether the other entries leave it. A characteristic whose domain no Values tab and no variant table enumerates — an interval, a free format — lists none.

values.description: The page's values, in the Values tab's order — or, where a variant table enumerates the domain, the values' natural order, digits as numbers.

next.description: The cursor of the next page, its request's `after`; absent on the last. The order values is listed in never changes from page to page.

total.description: How many values the request lists, on every page. A whole number.

ValueHelpRequest.description: `POST /customer/v1/value-help`: SAP's F4 on one characteristic within a configuration — the entry as the configuration route takes it, one explosion, no order — and the page asked for.

material.description: A material a sales order configures: any other is refused, `UNKNOWN_MATERIAL`.

characteristic.description: The CT04 name of the characteristic whose values to list: one an order can enter, any other refused, `UNKNOWN_CHARACTERISTIC`.

values.description: The entered values by CT04 name, as the configuration route takes them. The characteristic's own entry, if any, is taken out, so its list says what the others rule out — SAP's F4 on a valued field. A value is a string, or a number, read as its text.

soldToParty.description: The order header's sold-to party, `VBAK-KUNNR`, required where the material's `readsSoldToParty` is true: a customer number of at most 10 characters, digits alone read with their leading zeros (`9999999` is `0009999999`). It holds no control, bidirectional or invisible character, Unicode 17.0.0's default-ignorable code points among them but ZWNJ, ZWJ and the variation selectors: those the pattern names, and U+1BCA0 to U+1BCA3, U+1D173 to U+1D17A, U+E0000 to U+E00FF and U+E01F0 to U+E0FFF, beyond U+FFFF. Its length is counted in UTF-16 code units, as SAP counts a CHAR field: a character beyond U+FFFF counts two.

salesOrganization.description: `VBAK-VKORG`, required with the distribution channel, as the configuration route's: an area no material is sold in is `UNKNOWN_SALES_AREA`; a material not sold there is `MATERIAL_NOT_IN_SALES_AREA` where it is sold in another sales area the sign-in acts in, and `UNKNOWN_MATERIAL` at `/material` where in none, the inquiry's material aside.

search.description: Text the value or its text contains, in any case; every value where omitted or empty.

after.description: The `next` a page answered: the page after it. Opaque, versioned and holding a position alone; one for another request's search, or none the API wrote, is refused, `INVALID_CURSOR`.

limit.description: The most the page holds, a whole number from 1 to 200; 25 where omitted. Any other is refused, `INVALID_REQUEST`.

View.description: How a line is answered: the compact `summary` row of its decision facts, the default, at most 900 bytes besides the customer's fields it echoes, an inconsistent line's up to 2,000 with the messages its refused values and its pricing leave; or in `detail`, the lines `detailItems` names as the quotation prints each — its description, its specification in a line and in rows, the values it entered, its bill by process with each charge, its shares of the minimum groups, its weights, its sales text, its net price and every message with its variables — at most 8 KB each.
